---
description: Turn the confirmed spec into a short plan
---

# speckit.plan

Read the active spec in `speckit/station-specs/` (ask the student which one if unclear).

## Steps

1. Read `app/` structure first (it is small: `src/`, `public/art/`, `config.js`).
2. Append a `## Plan` section to the spec containing ONLY:
   - Files to touch (paths)
   - Libraries used (should already be in `app/package.json`; flag anything new)
   - Order of work (3–6 bullets)
3. State the constitution rules that apply (Fuji only, no keys, smallest change).
4. Show the plan to the student in ≤10 lines and get a go-ahead.

Do not write code in this phase. If the plan reveals the spec was wrong, fix the spec
first — the spec is the source of truth.
